verdict.rationale: Docs show SES exposes essentially all functionality — sending (raw/templated/simple), identity management, receipt rules, IP filtering, dedicated IPs, event publishing, IAM access control, and encryption — via SDK/API/SMTP rather than console-only features, consistent with AWS's general API-first console-as-a-client-of-the-API model. missing for 10: an explicit AWS statement asserting full UI/API parity, and independent/hands-on confirmation that no console-exclusive settings exist.
